question: g4_orders_list
answer:
Created [src/util/ordersApi.mjs](~/code/benchmark/okf-local/main/no_okf/work/g4_orders_list/no_okf/codex/1/src/util/ordersApi.mjs) — a no-import ES module exporting `normalizeOrderList(response)`, verified with node against a full response, a missing one, and a string-numeric field. It returns `{orders, pages, total, onThisPage}`, defaulting to `[]` / `0` when fields are absent.

Field mapping, derived from how the frontend consumes the backend's list response:

- `orders` ← `orders` (the list on this page, used directly in RecentOrder.js)
- `pages` ← `totalPages` (referenced in RecentOrder.js and Category.js)
- `total` ← `recordsTotal` (used in Category.js for the same list response shape)
- `onThisPage` ← `recordsCount` if present, otherwise the length of `orders`

Files I used: [src/pages/other/RecentOrder.js](~/code/benchmark/okf-local/main/no_okf/work/g4_orders_list/no_okf/codex/1/src/pages/other/RecentOrder.js) (the response consumer), [src/pages/category/Category.js](~/code/benchmark/okf-local/main/no_okf/work/g4_orders_list/no_okf/codex/1/src/pages/category/Category.js) (confirms `totalPages` / `recordsTotal` on the backend list response), and [src/util/webService.js](~/code/benchmark/okf-local/main/no_okf/work/g4_orders_list/no_okf/codex/1/src/util/webService.js) (confirms the page receives the raw response body). Since the backend repo isn't here, `onThisPage` falls back to the list length if the backend doesn't send a `recordsCount` field. No other files changed.

/bin/bash -lc "rg -ln \"total|page\" src/util src/helpers 2>/dev/null | head; echo ---; rg -n \"response\\.|res\\.\" src/util/webService.js | head -40"
